ms.report:
We are submitting the Proof of Achievement for Milestone 1 of the Statur project. This milestone established the foundational architecture and research framework for the Statur reputation system. Deliverables include the system architecture definition, reputation metric research, design of the data collection mechanism, initial UI/UX prototypes, and a working proof-of-concept demonstrating reputation score calculation.
All documentation and supporting materials for this milestone are available in the public repository: https://github.com/IagonAS/iagon-statur-reputation-system/blob/main/docs/catalyst/fund12-milestone-1.md
The repository acts as the single reference point for this milestone. All outputs, acceptance criteria, supporting materials, and verification links are structured there to allow reviewers to easily validate the milestone deliverables.
Following reviewer feedback, the supporting documentation has been updated with additional technical detail on the reputation token model, on-chain data persistence, reputation state machine, scoring model, custom scoring integration, backend architecture, database schema, and data-ingestion flows.
Following the approved Change Request, the documentation clarifies the data-collection architecture. The updated design introduces a flexible data-ingestion framework allowing reputation metrics to incorporate on-chain, off-chain, or hybrid data sources while maintaining the original objective of structured and verifiable reputation data processing.

This is the Proof of Achievement for Milestone 2, NFT and Reputation Contract Development, and further development. The milestone is complete. All six deliverables are in place: the final metrics, the karma points algorithm, proof of contracts submitted to audit, the complete Figma design, the app running on staging, and the infographic.
Each output below is paired with its acceptance criterion and the evidence that verifies it.
・All evidence is collected and structured in the project repository: https://github.com/IagonAS/iagon-statur-reputation-system/blob/main/docs/catalyst/fund12-milestone-2.md
・One demo video covers every output below: https://youtu.be/RNbqSJuVTCA

A. Output: Final qualitative and quantitative metrics, and the reputation calculation algorithm (karma points).
Statur is metric-agnostic. It does not impose a fixed set of metrics or one scoring formula, because each participating project defines its own metrics, value ranges, and weights. What is finalized and published is the scoring methodology: each metric value is multiplied by its weight, the products are summed, and the total is divided by the sum of the weights, with an exponential decay applied for inactivity.
Iagon's own instantiation of Statur applies that methodology with a concrete set of eight category weights that sum to 1.0, from Token Holder at 0.28 down to Storage Subscriber at 0.05. Users see the result as karma points.
The reputation backend implements the algorithm, computes score = (Σ(value · weight) / Σ(weight)) · e^(-days_inactive / decay_rate) per project and account, and returns it through an authenticated score endpoint. Calculations are running on staging, not only documented.
Acceptance criteria: Finalized metrics formulas and initiate calculations.
Evidence:
・Metrics and scoring methodology, with the taxonomy, formula, worked example, and decay behavior: https://docs.iagon.com/products/statur#reputation-scoring
